arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT "bookings" AS source, json_object("booking_id",b.booking_id,"request_id",b.request_id,"flight_id",b.flight_id,"passenger_id",b.passenger_id,"amount_cents",b.amount_cents,"status",b.status,"client_reference",b.client_reference,"charges",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("charge_id",c.charge_id,"key",c.idempotency_key,"amount",c.amount_cents,"state",c.state,"step",c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),"cancel",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("event_id",ce.event_id,"step",ce.step)) FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status <> "confirmed" UNION ALL SELECT "outbox",json_object("event_id",event_id,"booking_id",booking_id,"payload",payload,"status",status,"attempts",attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "flights",json_object("flight_id",flight_id,"capacity",capacity,"price",price_cents,"version",version) FROM flights

SELECT 'bookings' AS source, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',ce.event_id,'step',ce.step)) FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'fare_hold' AS source, json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) AS data FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'booking_log',json_object('id',id,'status',status,'message',message,'path',path) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='booking' AND status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'status',status,'reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings WHERE client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'pending' AS source,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'held',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'charge_id',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds

SELECT 'cancelled' AS source,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'cancel_events',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refund_cents',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_incomplete',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id) FROM bookings b WHERE status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',json_object('reference',client_reference,'count',COUNT(*)) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',json_object('flight',f.flight_id,'capacity',f.capacity,'holds',COUNT(h.booking_id)) FROM flights f JOIN holds h ON h.flight_id=f.flight_id GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(h.booking_id)>f.capacity
